decisionText: Approve ADR 0016 as presented: preserve the existing public root, main and tag identities and use the immutable post-root provenance supplement with its stated validation and evidence limits.

authorized: Adopt the post-root supplement as the local provenance and portable validation design.
Continue local validation and prepare the repair for normal publication review.
separateDecisions: Internal human review of the restored-history SPEC-014/015 candidate.
Any remote publication, pull request, merge or history operation.
